description.value: The Clove is a pizza and American-cuisine restaurant situated in a plaza on Quadra Island, a ferry-accessible island that attracts touring cyclists along the Discovery Islands route. The restaurant offers takeaway service and outdoor seating, making it a practical rest stop for riders exploring the island. Its location in Heriot Bay places it near the ferry terminal connecting Quadra Island to Campbell River.
